pector/connecting-servers.md): Connect to multiple MCP servers with different transport methods\n- [Projects](https://docs.mcpjam.

ersions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/protocol-versions.md): Pin the inspector to a specific MCP protocol version, including

ector/host-compat.md): See which hosts your MCP server will work in (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot) the moment you connect\n- [

ls effectively\n- [Playground](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/playground.md): Chat with your MCP servers, invoke tools by hand,
render widgets, and inspect every step, all in one IDE-style workspace\n- [Evaluate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md):
Author test cases for your MCP server, run them across models, and gate pass/fail on deterministic assertions plus optional LLM-a
s-judge.\n- [View origins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/view-origins.md): Which origin your MCP App's view runs at, and how t
o allowlist it with a third-party API\n- [Host presets](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/host-templates.md): What MCPJam's built-
in host presets capture, and which fields to get right when you mirror a host in your own Client.\n- [OAuth Debugger](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/inspector/guided-oauth.md): Debug your MCP server's OAuth implementation at every step of the handshake\n- [XAA Debugg
er](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/xaa-debugger.md): Configure and debug Cross-App Access flows with MCPJam as the test identit
y provider and client/agent\n- [Mid-session sign-in](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/lazy-authentication.md): Test servers that

com/inspector/tools-prompts-resources.md): Manually test your MCP server's tools, resources, and prompts\n- [Tracing & debugging](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/debugging.md): See all messages sent to and from your MCP server\n- [Telemetry & privacy](https:
//docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/telemetry-privacy.md): What the Inspector sends to analytics and error reporting, how links that act a
s credentials are kept out of it, and how to opt out\n- [Launch from Code (Beta)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/launch-from-co
de.md): Programmatically launch and configure MCPJam Inspector from your code or build tools\n- [MCP Docs Server](https://docs.mcp
jam.com/inspector/docs-server.md): Connect AI applications to MCPJam documentation\n- [My First MCP App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/g
uides/first-mcp-app.md): Build a simple Reservation MCP App from scratch\n- [My First ChatGPT App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/guides/
first-chatgpt-app-react.md): Build a simple Coffee Shop ChatGPT App with React\n- [CLI Overview](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overv
iew.md): Local MCP testing and mcpjam cloud: probing, debugging, OAuth, conformance, and hosted evals from your terminal\n- [Migra
